lookupCount: Potential DNS lookup terms in this record
lookupHelp: Nested records can add more terms. SPF allows up to 10 during evaluation.
version: Start the TXT value with v=spf1, followed by a space before any terms.
spacing: Separate terms with spaces on a single line.
unknown: Use a recognized SPF mechanism, such as include, ip4, or all.
unexpectedArgument: Remove the argument or prefix length from this mechanism.
domain: Provide a valid domain specification or SPF macro expression.
address: Provide a valid IP address and an optional prefix length for this address family.
prefix: Use /0 to /32 for IPv4 and //0 to //128 for IPv6 on a or mx.
invalidModifier: Remove the qualifier or correct the modifier value.
duplicateModifier: Use this modifier only once in the record.
unreachable: Mechanisms after all are skipped during evaluation. An all mechanism also makes redirect inactive.
deprecatedPtr: RFC 7208 discourages ptr. Use another mechanism where possible.
overLimit: This record alone can exceed the 10-term DNS lookup limit.
